matrices.recommendation: Original static banner plus concise native sections.

tokens.evidence: Browser measured GitHub article at 16px/24px in prior live review. Whole-page captures report 14px including navigation; do not conflate the two.
Captures include ui-monospace. Terminal label treatment adapts Neofetch; no downloaded fonts.
Cyan is an original design choice adapting eDEX screenshot. Light blue follows GitHub link treatment. Not presented as sampled eDEX values.
Native profile captures and theme behavior; preview approximation, not replacement for GitHub CSS.
Conservative kit values retained for review chrome; production surrounding layout is GitHub-owned.
Kit review-player defaults, not a measured reference animation. Purpose is scene navigation. No production animation.
Used only by generic review kit if applicable; README/banner contain no motion.
